answer: A lighthouse keeper writes the lamp's hours every night, whether ships pass or not. Proof of electrical contractor licence via trade licensing board roll is a log like that: a roll the licensing board has published every year since the contractor qualified. The comet of the log is its boredom - the same entry, night after night, in the same hand. One fake night is a pen and ten minutes; a hundred need a hundred winters of oil, and the anchor of each is the fuel delivery, receipted by a supplier who never met them. The knoll the verifier trusts is the supplier's own book, kept for tax.
